description: Which suite each web-lane spec belongs to. Every spec in web-tests/tests/ must be classified by exactly one suite - web-tests/suites.ts refuses to load otherwise, because an unclassified spec is one nobody decided about, and the failure mode is that it silently stops running.

regression.description: Case-backed, deterministic, unattended. Every spec here is named by a test-cases/Web-TC/TC-*.md file and writes to the database. Run this suite to answer 'did anything break'.

verification.description: Read-only, repeatable, no database write and no case file of its own. Connectivity and after-the-fact checks on documents other cases created.

model-check.description: Change-impact. Compares every screen model in web-tests/screens/ against the live system and names the cases at risk. Read-only. Run after a transport lands, before trusting a green regression run.

exploratory.description: Model-driven discovery: finding screens, ids and edge cases. Non-deterministic by design and never part of a regression answer. A spec graduates out of here by getting a case file, passing twice with no deviations, and being moved into 'regression' - see docs/test-authoring-guide.md, 'Freezing a case'.
